# DevAim Labs
> Custom software development studio based in the Netherlands. Direct contact with developers who build.

## Services

### Website & Portfolio Development
Fast, SEO-friendly websites and portfolios that convert. Built with Laravel, Vue.js, and modern web technologies.
URL: /diensten/websites

### Admin Panel Development
Replace spreadsheets with real tooling. Custom admin panels with roles, permissions, and audit logging.
URL: /diensten/adminpanelen

### KPI Dashboard Development
Real-time insight into your business data with live metrics, charts, and automated alerts.
URL: /diensten/dashboards

### Payment Integration
Stripe and Mollie integrations for checkout, subscriptions, and automatic invoicing.
URL: /diensten/betalingen

### API Integrations
REST APIs, webhooks, and synchronizations between your systems. Connect everything.
URL: /diensten/api-integraties
